Right edit adds 'if (minutes === 0) return 0;' before the negative check; this is a compatible early return and does not break the forward value-reference from evaluate.
Test asserts 'await scheduledDelay(40) > 0'; the corrupted left edit cannot satisfy this because the function no longer returns a numeric value.
